matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Predicting per-class binary masks with sigmoid avoids inter-class competition that arises when mask classes are normalized with softmax.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Decoupling mask and class prediction via per-class binary masks (sigmoid) gives 5.5 points mask AP gain over multinomial masks (softmax).

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN augments the Faster R-CNN detector with an additional, parallel head that outputs a per-instance binary segmentation mask for each proposal.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Mask R-CNN extends Faster R-CNN by adding a mask prediction branch in parallel with the classification and bounding box regression branch.

unmatched_a.a_claim_text_normalized: Detection accuracy of Mask R-CNN drops noticeably without ImageNet pre-training, indicating a dependence on large-scale supervised pre-training of the backbone.
